enabled.description: Append the mechanical entry to docs/LOGS.md.

publisher.description: The publisher command run at the session boundary; null means no publisher.

command.description: The command and its arguments, run without a shell.

timeoutMs.description: How long the publisher may run before it is abandoned, in milliseconds.

engram.description: Opt in to the Engram MCP registration; false writes nothing.

enabled.description: Measure the per-unit cost sample locally; false opts the project out.

jsonFile.description: Per-session JSONL destination, relative to the project root.

guard.description: One disposition per guard: allow (the guard stands down), deny (it refuses without asking) or ask (it asks when the host has a UI, and denies when it cannot). `default` is what every guard falls back to; a guard's own `mode` overrides it. Guards that can be configured here: gitIdentity, toolChoice, receipt. Always on and not configurable: pathProtection (tighten-only) and contentGuard (no bypass).

default.description: The disposition every guard falls back to when its own entry declares no mode. Shipped: ask.

gitIdentity.description: The agent-side `git config` write guard (issue #514). `ask` can really ask; a session with no UI is refused in every mode except `allow`.

mode.description: This guard's disposition; absent falls back to guard.default.

toolChoice.description: The command-time `rg`/`bun` carrier (issue #610). This guard cannot ask, so `ask` answers as `deny`.

mode.description: This guard's disposition; absent falls back to guard.default.

receipt.description: The inline PR-receipt guard (issue #182). This guard cannot ask, so `ask` answers as `deny`.

mode.description: This guard's disposition; absent falls back to guard.default.

gitIdentity.description: The approved commit identity and the agent-side config-write guard.

enforce.description: When the identity check runs: off, commit, push, push-upstream, or the commit-and-push pair.

approved.description: Only the declared facts are verified; an absent field is not checked.

fullName.description: The legal name a signing key's UID must carry.

format.description: The signing key format: openpgp or ssh.

signingKey.description: The resolved signing key: key id, fingerprint or path.

signingKeys.description: The per-machine keys: a resolved key matching any of these is approved (issue #546).

signing.description: required: a commit must carry a signature from an approved key. allowed (default): signing is optional, and a resolved key is verified when one resolves. off: the project approves unsigned commits, so a signed one is refused.

agentGuard.description: The model-facing half of the identity guard: the config keys the agent may write without asking.

allow.description: Config keys the agent may write without asking (e.g. user.name).

iterationsCap.description: The conductor's iteration ceiling per run.

sensitivePaths.description: Globs that raise the conductor's caution for a touched path.

securityPaths.description: Globs that join the conductor's security path set.

runLogPath.description: The advance run log, relative to the project root.

pathProtection.description: A tighten-only override: the shipped floor is always kept.

protectedGlobs.description: Extra globs to protect, on top of the shipped floor.

requirements.description: Per phase and operation requirement overrides; a value raises the floor, never lowers it.

pre-freeze.description: Requirements for pre-freeze writes (none, justification or approval).

create.description: The requirement for a create in the pre-freeze phase.

modify.description: The requirement for a modify in the pre-freeze phase.

delete.description: The requirement for a delete in the pre-freeze phase.

rename.description: The requirement for a rename in the pre-freeze phase.

post-freeze.description: Requirements for post-freeze writes (none, justification or approval).

create.description: The requirement for a create in the post-freeze phase.

modify.description: The requirement for a modify in the post-freeze phase.

delete.description: The requirement for a delete in the post-freeze phase.

rename.description: The requirement for a rename in the post-freeze phase.

always.description: Requirements for always writes (none, justification or approval).

create.description: The requirement for a create at any phase.

modify.description: The requirement for a modify at any phase.

delete.description: The requirement for a delete at any phase.

rename.description: The requirement for a rename at any phase.

contentGuard.description: Author-provenance policy for third-party forge content: which authors are ingested as readable content.

trustedRoles.description: The author associations whose content may be ingested; every other association is excluded and declared.

allowLogins.description: Logins admitted regardless of association — an explicit, reviewable exception list.

denyLogins.description: Logins excluded regardless of association; a deny always beats an allow.

mode.description: keep-all detects only; archive lets the trim step run.

pendingTrimAfterDays.description: How long the sensor waits before offering a merge, from the unit's last log entry.

archiveRetentionDays.description: Prune the archive after this many days; null never prunes it.

seamHook.description: The project-declared offsite copy, run after the local archive is durable.
